crossRefs.note: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly…
Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a…
For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy…
to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive…
seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the…
You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day.…
But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or…
Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not…
You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on…

translations.web: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;
translations.bsb: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.
translations.kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
translations.asv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were enlightened, ye endured a great conflict of sufferings;
